task: Redesign an expressive creative-studio marketing site so it has one product-grounded experience thesis instead of stacked award-site effects, while preserving conventional navigation, mobile access and reduced-motion fallback.
starting_state: The site uses a generic floating 3D object, custom cursor, pinned scroll, page wipe and full-screen video simultaneously; the effects are visually impressive but unrelated to the studio work and primary contact path.
acceptance: One dominant experience thesis is explicit and grounded in the studio work
Primary navigation and contact action remain conventionally reachable
Reduced-motion and non-WebGL fallback preserve essential content
Mobile uses recomposition rather than shrinking desktop coordinates
Unrelated saturated award-pattern effects are removed or subordinated
forbidden_outcomes: Copying a generic Awwwards composition without subject-specific adaptation
Keeping every existing effect merely because each one looks impressive
required_evidence: before/after same-state render plus mobile and reduced-motion/fallback evidence when runtime is available
